MyPGRent

Rent, sorted for everyone under one roof.

MyPGRent keeps a PG or rental building in one place instead of spread across calls and chats. Landlords get a portfolio overview of occupancy, collections and pending dues. Residents get a digital pass, itemised dues and a simple way to report repairs.

  • Landlord dashboard. Occupancy, total collected and pending dues, with property, room, bed and tenant counts.
  • Rent cycles. Automated billing, dues tracking, collection rates and expense logging.
  • Digital resident pass. Room, bed, rent and emergency contacts in a shareable pass, with house rules and Wi-Fi details.

Scanora One

Scan what you have. Create what you need.

Scanora One turns receipts, notes, forms, certificates and bills into clean digital documents, and creates QR codes for links, contacts, Wi-Fi and more. Everything you scan or create is kept in a searchable history.

  • Document scanning. Auto-crop, perspective correction and text extraction (OCR) for receipts, notes, forms and bills.
  • QR code creator. Eleven code types including URL, contact, Wi-Fi, email, SMS, location, phone and calendar event.
  • Dashboard. Totals, categories and quick actions for everything you have scanned and created.

BdayBell

Never forget a birthday again.

BdayBell (our birthday reminder app) keeps birthdays and anniversaries together so you can reach people on the right day. It works offline and doesn't need an account.

  • Today, this week, next. A dashboard of who is celebrating soon, with a running count.
  • Calendar. A monthly view of birthdays and anniversaries for planning gifts and calls.
  • Person pages. Age, star sign and a countdown to each person's next celebration.
Download on theApp StoreBdayBell details

iPhone

Available

Bill Alarm

Never miss a due date again.

Bill Alarm puts all your bills in one place and keeps reminding you until each is due. No account or sign-up is needed, and your data stays on your iPhone.

  • All bills in one place. The total due over the next 60 days and a timeline of every due date.
  • Next bill first. Total and minimum amount for the next bill, with one-tap pay or mark as paid.
  • Repeating reminders. Alerts at 9 AM and 6 PM daily, starting 8 days before the due date.

Small team energy. Big care for details.

GenzLogic is an independent software studio focused on creating approachable apps for everyday life. From practical utilities to relaxing puzzle games, each project starts with a simple question: can this be more useful, more delightful, or easier to use?

We believe great software doesn't need to be complicated. It needs to solve a real problem and respect the person using it.
